item.title: Delaware State Rep. Introduces HB 279 Right to Repair
item.description: (DOVER, Del) – A Sussex County Representative is introducing a bill to help boaters potentially make repairs at a faster rate. item.title: Leonard’s Mill Boat Ramp to Close Feb. 1 for Replacement
item.description: SALISBURY, Md. – Leonard’s Mill boat ramp, located adjacent to the Wicomico County Welcome Center, will close for replacement beginning Feb. 1. The pavilion, dog park, parking lot, and portalets will remain accessible for use. The project is slated to be complete by mid-April.
